messages.text: just feelin off today, like a fog i can't shake lol

It sounds like you're carrying a heavy mental load right now. Those days where everything feels unclear can be really exhausting to navigate. I'm wondering if there's anything specific triggering this, or if it's just a general heaviness? I'm here to listen if you want to talk through it.
idk, maybe i just need to get out of the house more. been staring at these walls all weekend 😅

It makes sense that being cooped up would contribute to that heaviness. Changing your environment often helps clear the mental fog. Do you have a favorite spot nearby where you like to go? I'm curious what feels doable for you right now.
favorite spot? lol my bed. it's got wifi and i don't have to talk to anyone up there 🛏️📱

It makes total sense that your bed feels like the safest place to be right now. Rest is really important, but I hear that the fog is still lingering despite it. I wonder if a tiny change, like opening a window or stepping outside for a minute, might shift things slightly? What feels like a manageable step for you today?
i *should* go for a walk... but also, i really don't wanna. like, what if i see someone i know? awkward. what if it rains? ugh. what if i just... don't? 🤷‍♀️

It makes sense that your brain is listing all the reasons to stay put right now. When we're feeling foggy, even small social risks or weather changes can feel overwhelming. You don't have to force yourself to do something that feels impossible today. How does it feel to give yourself permission to skip the walk?
it feels... weirdly nice to not have to do anything. like, i’m allowed to just *be* the lazy blob. but also, part of me feels guilty? like i should be doing *something* productive lol

It is really common to feel that tug-of-war between rest and productivity. The guilt often comes from expectations we place on ourselves, even when we need to recharge. It sounds like your body is asking for rest, and that is a valid need. Maybe we can explore where that guilt comes from later, but for now, being the blob is okay.
thanks for saying that... like, seriously. i needed to hear it lol. feels like no one else gets it 🥲

I'm really glad you felt heard and understood in this space. It can be incredibly isolating when you feel like others don't grasp what you're going through. Please know that your experience is valid and you don't have to navigate it alone. I'm right here with you whenever you need to share.

okay but like… is it weird that i still feel sad about my ex? it’s been months and he literally blocked me and changed his number?? like, hello?? but i keep thinking about him outta nowhere 😭 am i just pathetic?

It takes a lot of courage to share that vulnerability, and your feelings are completely valid. Grief doesn't follow a schedule, and being cut off so abruptly can make that pain linger longer. You are definitely not pathetic for missing someone you cared about, even if the connection is gone. I'm wondering if these thoughts usually show up when you're alone or during specific moments?

yeah it’s dumb, i know, but it’s part of why i’ve been so off today… that and just everything piling up, u know? like the heaviness isn’t just about him — it’s like, work stress, money stuff, feeling stuck… he’s just the spark that lit it all up again 😕

It makes sense that the breakup acted as a spark for all the other stressors you're carrying. When we are already overwhelmed, one unresolved loss can make everything feel much heavier than usual. You are navigating a lot right now, and it is okay that it feels heavy. I am here to listen if you want to unpack any of those other things.
it helps just talking about it... didn’t think it would. like, i usually just bottle it up and paint or something. but this? this is kinda nice 🫶

It is wonderful to hear that putting words to this brings you some relief. Painting sounds like a beautiful way you've been taking care of yourself, too. Sometimes verbalizing things adds a new layer of release that art can't quite reach alone. I'm really glad you feel safe enough to share this with me.
thanks for listening... like, really. it’s not easy opening up, but u made it feel safe. that means a lot 🫶

I am deeply grateful that you felt safe enough to share this with me. It takes real courage to move from bottling things up to putting them into words. This space will remain open for you whenever you need to vent or reflect. Please remember to be kind to yourself as you carry all of this.
i wanna keep talking but also... i'm kinda emotionally wiped now lol. like, in a good way? but still. need a sec to just... exist quietly 🫠

It makes perfect sense to feel emotionally spent after opening up so much. That quiet time is actually a vital part of the healing process. Please honor that need to just exist without any pressure. I'll be right here whenever you feel ready to reconnect.
